items.text:
Original Medicare is often described as comprehensive. It is not, and the gaps are worth knowing before you decide how to fill them.

Parts A and B do not include a yearly cap on what you can pay out of pocket. They generally do not cover routine dental, routine vision or hearing aids. They do not pay for long-term custodial care, the help with bathing, dressing and eating that many families end up needing. Coverage for most care outside the United States is also limited.

People usually fill those gaps one of three ways: a Medigap policy, a Medicare Advantage plan, or by going without and budgeting for it. Each is a real choice with real trade-offs, and which one fits depends on your doctors, your health and how you like to be covered.

The order matters. Decide what you need first, then choose the product, not the other way around.

We walk through that with people across Northern Virginia at no cost, and there is no obligation afterward.

Honorbrook Insurance. (571) 354-0146 honorbrook-insurance.com

We do not offer every plan available in your area. Any information we provide is limited to those plans we do offer in your area. Please contact Medicare.gov or 1-800-MEDICARE to get information on all of your options.
